card.name: Negation after do, does, or has
card.fires_on: The word not (or no) right after do, does, has or is, where it negates the next verb or phrase. Also the word right after it, such as part or known.

modes.label: Not after do/does
modes.description: The word not follows do or does and negates a following verb, in label instructions or factual statements.
modes.example: Discontinue RYLAZE and do<< not>> make up missed doses.

modes.label: Descriptive negation in encyclopedic text
modes.description: Not or no marks a property something lacks, such as a city being not part of a county.
modes.example: It is an independent city and<< not>> part of any county.

card.writes: It pushes toward words that continue a negated or limiting phrase and away from words meaning fully or perfectly.
card.plain: It fires on the word "not" or "no" when a sentence says something does not do or have something.
